rel.line.topic.weather.0: The fog this morning was thick enough to cut.
rel.line.topic.weather.1: If the wind turns, rain comes tomorrow.
rel.line.topic.weather.2: My knee aches, the weather will turn.
rel.line.topic.weather.3: The sun is out, the washing will finally dry.
rel.line.topic.weather.4: The nights got cool, time to bring out the quilt.
rel.line.topic.weather.5: The clouds hang low, and so do the swallows.
rel.line.topic.weather.6: Frost is at the door, keep plenty of firewood.
rel.line.topic.weather.7: This rain will bring blessings to the crops.
rel.line.topic.weather.8: I prayed the roof wouldn't fly off in the storm.
rel.line.topic.weather.9: Nobody should sit indoors on a day like this.
rel.line.topic.harvest.0: The ears are full this year, the mill will feast.
rel.line.topic.harvest.1: The crows have made my field their home.
rel.line.topic.harvest.2: The soil is tired, it wants manure.
rel.line.topic.harvest.3: I swear the weeds grow faster than the crop.
rel.line.topic.harvest.4: Did you keep back the heirloom seed?
rel.line.topic.harvest.5: If harvest starts early, our hands will rest.
rel.line.topic.harvest.7: Don't skip the watering, the roots get thirsty.
rel.line.topic.harvest.8: That field should lie fallow a while.
rel.line.topic.harvest.9: My heart rests easy when the granary is full.
rel.line.topic.animals.0: The cow gave two pails of milk this morning.
rel.line.topic.animals.1: I heard a wolf last night.
rel.line.topic.animals.2: The hens are roosting on the fence again.
rel.line.topic.animals.3: The lambs got mixed into the flock, I can't tell them apart.
rel.line.topic.animals.4: The horse's shoe is loose, I'll take it to the smith.
rel.line.topic.animals.5: The cat gave up the mouse and lay in the sun.
rel.line.topic.animals.6: The dog barked all night, it sensed something.
rel.line.topic.animals.7: The bees are gentle this year.
rel.line.topic.animals.8: The goat got into the garden again.
rel.line.topic.animals.9: The highland move is near, the flock is restless.
rel.line.topic.food.0: I dried the tarhana early this year.
rel.line.topic.food.1: The sourdough took, the bread rose well.
rel.line.topic.food.2: The molasses pot is boiling, you can smell it down the lane.
rel.line.topic.food.3: Nobody makes stew like my mother.
rel.line.topic.food.4: The cheese aged well this winter.
rel.line.topic.food.5: Don't let the paste go thin when you boil it.
rel.line.topic.food.6: Bulgur pilaf is lovely with onion.
rel.line.topic.food.7: I laid down pickles in the cellar, every colour.
rel.line.topic.food.8: The smell of helva took me back to childhood.
rel.line.topic.food.9: When fresh fish fries, the whole village gets hungry.
rel.line.topic.mine.0: I saw a vein in the mine today.
rel.line.topic.mine.1: Water is seeping in the gallery, it needs props.
rel.line.topic.mine.2: Coal dust is no good for the lungs.
rel.line.topic.mine.3: If we lay the rail a bit further, hauling gets easier.
rel.line.topic.mine.4: The rock is harder down deep.
rel.line.topic.mine.5: When the torch dies, your heart goes dark.
rel.line.topic.mine.6: Since the cave-in I tie a cloth over my mouth.
rel.line.topic.mine.8: Coming out of the mine, the sun blinds me.
rel.line.topic.mine.9: The pick's point is blunt, it needs sharpening.
rel.line.topic.craft.0: With the new plane the wood comes out like silk.
rel.line.topic.craft.1: If the bellows draw well, the iron glows fast.
rel.line.topic.craft.2: The cloth is half done on the loom.
rel.line.topic.craft.3: A pot cracked in the kiln, what a shame.
rel.line.topic.craft.4: A saddle's stitching must be strong.
rel.line.topic.craft.5: You can tell a master's hand.
rel.line.topic.craft.6: Pour the wax slowly and it won't bubble.
rel.line.topic.craft.7: I need to get the saw sharpened.
rel.line.topic.craft.8: My grandchildren will use this chest.
rel.line.topic.craft.9: You plane along the grain of the wood.
rel.line.topic.children.0: Our little one took a first step today.
rel.line.topic.children.1: The children never tire of the spinning top.
rel.line.topic.children.2: Our boy wants to become an apprentice.
rel.line.topic.children.3: My daughter is learning her letters, bless her.
rel.line.topic.children.4: Children are meant to be naughty.
rel.line.topic.children.5: Ours won't come down from the tree house.
rel.line.topic.children.6: They won't sleep without a story.
rel.line.topic.children.7: The teenage years are hard, you need patience.
rel.line.topic.children.8: You shouldn't leave a child alone.
rel.line.topic.children.9: Loving a grandchild is something else.
rel.line.topic.festival.0: The festival is close, there's much to prepare.
rel.line.topic.festival.1: How the horses raced at the last fair!
rel.line.topic.festival.2: Who'll lead the dance this year?
rel.line.topic.festival.3: What shall we bring to the Bounty Table?
rel.line.topic.festival.4: I've missed the Winter Night tales.
rel.line.topic.festival.5: I made a wish at the Seed Festival.
rel.line.topic.festival.6: The biggest gourd at the Harvest Festival was ours.
rel.line.topic.festival.7: When I hear the drum I can't keep still.
rel.line.topic.festival.8: They say the sulking make up at festivals.
rel.line.topic.festival.9: I'm entering the contest this year.
rel.line.topic.trade.0: Salt got dearer, the merchant's doing as he likes.
rel.line.topic.trade.1: Wool fetched nothing at the market today.
rel.line.topic.trade.2: The travelling merchant spoke of far lands.
rel.line.topic.trade.4: When the caravan comes, the village comes alive.
rel.line.topic.trade.5: You have to deliver orders on time.
rel.line.topic.trade.6: I'll save my coin and buy land.
rel.line.topic.trade.7: They say debt is the whip of the brave.
rel.line.topic.trade.8: My stall sold out of food today.
rel.line.topic.hunt.0: I saw roe deer tracks in the forest.
rel.line.topic.hunt.1: Keep away from the bear, especially with cubs.
rel.line.topic.hunt.2: A hare fell into the trap.
rel.line.topic.hunt.4: You don't hunt a mother with young, it's shameful.
rel.line.topic.hunt.5: There are wild ducks by the lake.
rel.line.topic.hunt.8: What lovely shade under the great plane tree.
rel.line.topic.hunt.9: The sound of the forest is restful.
rel.line.topic.home.0: I whitewashed the wall, the house brightened.
rel.line.topic.home.1: The hearth is sooty, the chimney needs sweeping.
rel.line.topic.home.2: We laid a new rug, the room feels different.
rel.line.topic.home.3: The basil in the pot smells lovely.
rel.line.topic.home.4: The roof drips, it needs new thatch.
rel.line.topic.home.6: The shelf gave way, everything fell.
rel.line.topic.home.7: I love sitting by the window.
rel.line.topic.home.8: I'd like our house in the home contest too.
rel.line.topic.home.9: I made up the guest room.
rel.line.topic.season.1: In summer heat, shade is worth gold.
rel.line.topic.season.4: Everyone falls ill when the season turns.
rel.line.topic.season.5: This season went by so fast.
rel.line.topic.season.6: When snow falls the village goes quiet.
rel.line.topic.season.8: Grape harvest is my favourite time.
rel.line.joke.0: They asked the wise man where the world's centre is. Where my donkey stands, he said.
rel.line.joke.1: The neighbour borrowed a cauldron and returned it with a little pot inside: your cauldron gave birth, he said.
rel.line.joke.2: The hen laid the egg and the rooster took the credit.
rel.line.joke.3: Even the donkey knows what's what, it's just too shy to ask.
rel.line.joke.4: The smith never jokes, he hammers before the iron cools.
rel.line.joke.5: The miller won't sell bread untasted, and half is gone while tasting.
rel.line.joke.6: Fishermen don't lie, the fish just shrink.
rel.line.joke.7: The cat calls the liver it can't reach rotten.
rel.line.joke.8: The goat ran to the mountain and the shepherd sang after it.
rel.line.joke.9: I fell asleep counting sheep, then the sheep counted me.
rel.line.joke.10: Morning doesn't come because the rooster crows, but ours believes it.
rel.line.joke.11: He stepped on the branch the goat was on, and down they both came.
rel.line.joke.12: A blind judge, a deaf witness, what a fine court!
rel.line.joke.13: If our donkey could talk, it'd sulk at me first.
rel.line.joke.14: I bought a rooster at market, it sets the time itself.
rel.line.joke.15: The pot boiled, I dozed, and dinner didn't wait for me.
rel.line.joke.16: The bear got into the hive, and the bees fled to the hills.
rel.line.joke.17: The wolf loves foggy weather, and I love soup.
rel.line.joke.18: The merchant got so confused he weighed himself.
rel.line.joke.19: The mouse taught the cat a lesson; the cat listened, then ate it.
rel.line.joke.20: The farmer prayed for rain and got a flood; next time ask for less, they said.
rel.line.joke.21: I forgot the basket on my back and looked for it all day.
rel.line.joke.22: The hare slept, the tortoise slept too, the race still goes on.
rel.line.joke.23: Our dog doesn't bark at thieves, only at the kitchen.
rel.line.joke.24: The mill turns, but nobody knows where the flour goes.
rel.line.joke.25: They threw the quilt in the fire and cheered they'd got rid of the fleas.
rel.line.joke.26: They say old goats love mint; ours likes the smokehouse.
rel.line.joke.27: Forty wise men can't fish out the stone a fool throws in the well.
rel.line.joke.28: I just bought a goose and it chases me; who owns whom, I can't say.
rel.line.joke.29: What does a donkey know of compote? I do!
rel.line.story.0: My grandfather used to say seven brothers dug this village's first well.
rel.line.story.1: Once the mill burned and the whole village rebuilt it together.
rel.line.story.2: Do you know the tale of the shepherd who danced with a wolf on Winter Night?
rel.line.story.3: Nobody knows who planted the great plane tree, but I do.
rel.line.story.4: The horseless knight passed this way and turned his sword into a plough.
rel.line.story.5: In my youth the snow fell so deep we couldn't open the door.
rel.line.story.6: My grandmother said: who wastes bread loses their blessing.
rel.line.story.7: Once a sheep spoke, and nobody believed it.
rel.line.song.0: Poplars by the stream, their leaves are falling...
rel.line.song.1: The highland road is stony, the bride's feet bleed...
rel.line.song.2: There's henna on your white hand, and a sweetheart in my heart...
rel.line.song.3: The mill turns, flour comes, my longing never ends...
rel.line.song.4: The moon rises, a star falls, I watch for you to come...
rel.line.song.5: The wind blows on the threshing floor, the grain gold, the heart wild...
rel.line.react.laugh.4: I'm telling that one at home.
rel.line.chat_leave.0: I have work to do, stay well.
rel.line.debunk.0: That's a lie! I was there.
rel.line.gossip.fight.0: Did you hear? {a} and {b} came to blows in the square!
rel.line.gossip.fight.1: They say {a} got into a fight, eye's black and blue.
rel.line.gossip.fight.2: {a} and {b} kicked up quite a dust cloud.
rel.line.gossip.argument.1: You could hear {a} all down the street.
rel.line.gossip.sulk.0: {a} is sulking at {b}, won't even say hello.
rel.line.gossip.flirt.2: Our {a} has lost their heart, I think.
rel.line.gossip.sweethearts.1: {a} and {b} are sweethearts, did you know?
rel.line.gossip.sweethearts.2: They say a handkerchief changed hands.
rel.line.gossip.broke_engagement.0: {a} broke off the engagement and returned the ring!
rel.line.gossip.break_up.0: {a} and {b} split up, the handkerchief went back.
rel.line.gossip.break_up.1: {b}'s heart is broken, eyes full of tears.
rel.line.gossip.wedding.0: What a lovely wedding {a} and {b} had!
rel.line.gossip.wedding.1: The drum and shawm played till morning.
rel.line.gossip.wedding.2: The bride broke the jug in one throw!
rel.line.gossip.infidelity.0: Don't tell anyone, but {a} was seen with someone else...
rel.line.gossip.infidelity.1: {a} and {b} have been meeting in secret.
rel.line.gossip.infidelity.2: Poor thing, the spouse doesn't know.
rel.line.gossip.separation.0: {b} went back to the family home because of {a}.
rel.line.gossip.separation.1: A home has broken, what a pity.
rel.line.gossip.rumor.0: They say the {house} household's scales weigh short.
rel.line.gossip.rumor.1: Things are a mess at the {house} household.
rel.line.gossip.rumor.2: They say {a} never keeps their word.
rel.line.gossip.rumor.3: A foul smell comes from the {house} house, they say.
rel.line.gossip.lost_child.0: {a}'s child was wandering about alone again.
rel.line.gossip.lost_child.1: A child shouldn't be left alone.
rel.line.gossip.filth.0: You can't get past {a}'s yard for the smell.
rel.line.gossip.filth.1: {a} behind a bush... well, I won't say.
rel.line.gossip.animal_talk.0: {a} says they talked with an animal!
rel.line.gossip.animal_talk.1: I think {a} got too much sun.
rel.line.gossip.word_given.0: Word has been given for {a} and {b}!
rel.line.gossip.word_given.1: He drank the salty coffee without a grimace!
rel.line.gossip.donation.0: {a} donated to the charity kitchen, how generous.
rel.line.gossip.generic.1: There's news going round the village.
rel.line.gossip.generic.2: I don't know if you've heard, but...
rel.line.argue.1: Who do you think you are!
rel.line.argue.5: How many times have I told you!
rel.line.jab.2: Whoever eats {b}'s cooking never comes back.
rel.line.jab.6: Oh {b}, there's no talking to you.
rel.line.sulk.2: I'll never look at you again.
rel.line.apology.1: If I hurt you, I'm sorry.
rel.line.accept_apology.0: All right, it's water under the bridge.
rel.line.accept_apology.1: You were a little right too.
rel.line.bayram.0: It's a feast day, no sulking!
rel.line.bayram.1: Come, let me kiss your hand, let's make up for the feast.
rel.line.bayram.2: Nobody stays cross on festival day.
rel.line.cane.2: Rude! Oh, the youth of today!
rel.line.cane.3: I don't carry this cane for nothing!
rel.line.witness_fight.2: Shameful, in the middle of the village!
rel.line.separate.1: Break it up, this isn't right!
rel.line.handkerchief_offer.1: Take it, my heart is in this handkerchief.
rel.line.handkerchief_yes.0: I'll keep it all my life.
rel.line.handkerchief_no.0: Forgive me, I can't take it.
rel.line.asking_greet.1: Good evening, if you'll receive us.
rel.line.asking_greet.2: We've come on a happy errand.
rel.line.salty_ok.1: I've never had one like it.
rel.line.salty_bad.1: What did you put in this?
rel.line.ask_hand.0: By God's will and the Prophet's word, we ask your daughter's hand for our son.
rel.line.ask_hand.1: Their hearts are one, let us be one too.
rel.line.ask_yes.0: We give our blessing, may it be a happy one!
rel.line.ask_yes.1: If the young ones agree, so do we.
rel.line.ask_yes.2: May they grow old on one pillow.
rel.line.ask_think.0: Let us think, we'll send word.
rel.line.ribbon.1: I've cut the ribbon, may your luck be open.
rel.line.henna_song.0: Let them not build houses on high hills...
rel.line.henna_song.1: Henna is applied, the bride weeps...
rel.line.henna_tears.1: Don't cry, or I'll cry too.
rel.line.procession.1: Beat the drum, play the shawm!
rel.line.door_tip.0: No bride without a door tip!
rel.line.jar_whole.0: The jug didn't break... never mind, blessings will come.
rel.line.toast.4: Long live the bride and groom!
rel.line.anniversary.0: Another year passed, I'm glad you're here.
rel.line.anniversary.2: I love you like the first day.
